overview_description.description: Cashfree Payments is a payments and banking technology company that enables many businesses to accept and send money efficiently. The platform supports various payment modes including UPI, cards, net banking, and wallets, alongside features like instant refunds and loan disbursements. Cashfree Payments provides a Merchant app for businesses to manage their payments and access their accounts anytime, anywhere.

about_short_description.short_description: Cashfree Payments is a fintech company that provides payment processing, payouts, and API banking solutions for businesses.

product.name: Cashfree Payment Gateway
product.description: A payment processing platform for accepting domestic and international online payments through websites, apps, Shopify stores, and other platforms.

product.name: Cashfree Payouts
product.description: An API-driven disbursement platform for sending money to bank accounts, UPI IDs, cards, and wallets for vendor payments, refunds, wages, and other use cases.

product.name: Cashfree International Payments
product.description: Cross-border payment services that let Indian businesses accept payments in more than 140 currencies and receive settlements in INR, with additional global collection accounts.

product.name: Cashfree Subscriptions
product.description: A recurring payments platform for creating mandates and automatically collecting scheduled payments through cards, UPI, and bank accounts.

product.name: Cashfree Secure ID
product.description: An identity verification and onboarding platform for KYC, bank account, document, Aadhaar, GST, face-match, geolocation, and related verification workflows.

product.name: Cashfree RiskShield
product.description: A machine-learning transaction risk and fraud prevention platform that analyzes payment activity and applies configurable rules to detect, block, or review suspicious transactions.
